bushes.line: Sanctimonious sycophants stir in the bushes
bushes.lineNext: Up to the stand with your foot on the bible

bushes.line: Woman, you got too many brambles hiding under these bushes
stanza: But do I hate what she is or do I want to be her? (Do I want to be her?)
And don’t we love something fresh? Anything new, virgin
Woman, you got too many brambles hiding under these bushes
Woman, you got too many brambles but I always liked a good storm

bushes.line: One little hut among the bushes
stanza: One little hut among the bushes
Still sadly to my memory rushes
When will I see the bees a humming
When shall I hear the banjo strumming
Down in my good old home

bushes.line: We can beat around the bushes
stanza: We can beat around the bushes
We can get down to the bone
We can leave it in the parkin' lot
